algorithm: Compute the absolute values of the inputs.
Use the Euclidean algorithm to find the GCD.
Return the result as a scalar if both inputs are scalars, otherwise return as a list.
constraints: Inputs must be integers or 1-D lists of integers.
Supports broadcasting for scalar/scalar, scalar/list, list/scalar, and lists of the same length.
Values and results fit signed int64.
edge_cases: Negative numbers are handled by taking absolute values.
Scalar inputs return integers, list inputs return lists.
inputs: x and y are integers or 1-D lists of integers. Support scalar/scalar, scalar/list, list/scalar and lists of the same length (including empty). Scalar/scalar returns int, all other inputs return a list. No other broadcasting is required. Values and results fit signed int64.
output: A scalar if both x and y are scalars, otherwise a list. The output is the GCD of the absolute values of the inputs.
purpose: Compute the greatest common divisor (GCD) of two inputs.
